case_title: ILYA E RYZHENKO VS. ROBERT EARL CHARLES JR

docket_entries.description: STIPULATION FOR HEARING BEFORE PRO TEM COMMISSIONER FILED BY RYZHENKO, ILYA E CHARLES JR, ROBERT EARL

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF JUL-12-2018 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF JUL-12-2018 BY PRO TEM ANNE WONG. 506 PLAINTIFF ILYA RYZHENKO IS PRESENT, ASSISTED BY LEONID RYZHENKO FOR RUSSIAN TO ENGLISH INTERPRETATION WHO IS NOT A COURT CERTIFIED RUSSIAN INTERPRETER. PLAINTIFF BROUGHT NON COURT CERTIFIED RUSSIAN INTERPRETER ON THEIR OWN ACCOUNT AND DID NOT REQUEST AN INTERPRETER FROM COURT PROPERLY PRIOR TO HEARING. THE INTERPRETER'S OFFICE WAS NOT ABLE TO PROVIDE A CERTIFIED RUSSIAN INTERPRETER UPON TIME OF HEARING. CLERK GARY FELICIANO ADMINISTERED THE INTERPRETER'S OATH TO LEONID RYZHENKO. PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM: ANNE WONG; CLERK: G. FELICIANO; NOT REPORTED. (506)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JUL-12-2018 - JUDGMENT.
